Recipe.Title: Rusty Guacamole
Recipe.Source: From the kitchen of Rusty Taco Via Josh VanOrman
Recipe.Description:
Guacamole is just one of the things you can dip nacho chips into. But it is one of the best things you can dip nacho chips into!
This recipe is based on one from a restaurant named Rusty Taco, and it is AWESOME!!!
(You may want to check out the recipe for Rusty Queso to include with this.)
One thing to note: The original recipe was for a few days' worth at a restaurant, but this recipe cuts it down to an amount reasonable for a family. As such, in a couple of cases, the amounts are odd, so there may be some leftover ingredients. (For example, ¼ of a Jalapeño.)

section.instruction: Cut the Avocados in half and remove the pit. Then scoop the pulp out into a medium-large bowl.
Mash the Avocados until chunks are no larger than ¼&inch;.
Add Lime Juice, Granulated Garlic, and Kosher Salt, then mix well.
Add diced Tomato, diced Onion, and diced Jalepeño into Guacamole and stir gently.

Notes.note: Make absolutely sure the Avocados are fully ripe and ready for mashing. If not, you will get a chunky, mixture that is not really Guacamole, and it will be a disappointment.

Make sure this is stored in an air-tight container in the refrigerator, or it will turn an ugly blackish color.
Even with this, it will last less than a week!

Modifications.modification: Obviously, you can increase (or decrease) the amount of Jalapeños to adjust how hot it is.
